overview.about: The CJ Cup Byron Nelson honours the great Texan champion Byron Nelson and is played at TPC Craig Ranch near Dallas. One of the PGA Tour's charitable cornerstones, it is a birdie-fest on a modern, forgiving layout.
overview.nextEvent: The next CJ Cup Byron Nelson is played at TPC Craig Ranch in McKinney, Texas. Soft, scorable conditions usually mean a very low winning total in front of big Dallas galleries.
